references.text: John 11:5 further confirms the relationship between Jesus and Lazarus's family, mentioned in verse 1, by stating that Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
John 11:18 specifies exactly where Bethany was located, the hometown of Lazarus and his sisters mentioned in verse 1, by saying that Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
John 11:19-20 describes Martha and Mary's actions and role in the events introduced in verse 1, by telling that many Jews had come to comfort them, and that Martha went out to meet Jesus.
John 11:21 refers to Lazarus's illness and death introduced in verse 1, as Martha says to Jesus: 'Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died'.
John 11:32 shows Mary's reaction to Lazarus's death, introduced in verse 1, by describing that she fell at Jesus' feet and said the same words as Martha.
